rules.text: Sika® Level SkimCoat is a one-component, easy to use and fast drying, cementitious skim mortar ideal for the repair or reprofiling of concrete, approved wood subfloors, and correctly prepared ceramic or quarry tiles before the installation of SikaFloor® Levelling products, SikaTile® adhesives or final floor coverings
rules.heading: DESCRIPTION

rules.text: Not suitable for exposed repairs or resurfacing.
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Do not apply onto dimensionally unstable substrates.
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Do not use on presswood, flakeboard, metallic or similar substrates and always comply with the final floor manufacturer’s recommendations or instructions as to substrate or subfloor standards.
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Not suitable for use on water soluble adhesive residues or those which suffer from migration/bleeding.
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Not suitable for applications where hydrostatic pressure is present.
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Plywood Subfloors: They must consist of exteriorgrade wood which complies with Group 1 CC Type, is engineer approved and either recommended or warranted by the wood manufacturer or final floor covering supplier
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY / PRE-TREATMENT

rules.text: Well prepared non-absorbent, smooth, sound substrates such water-based epoxies (SikaFloor® 158W Fast Barrier or Sikalastic® Moisture Seal or concrete treated with silicate products must be primed with SikaFloor® 14 Prep "N" Prime
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE QUALITY / PRE-TREATMENT
